blockingFindings.title: Mismatch envelope omits requested runId
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH to return expectedRunId when it is available. In the runId path, execute() knows the requested runId, but activeFlowMismatch() always emits expectedRunId: null, so `senti flow get status <runId> --expect-issue <n>` loses a required machine-readable identifier.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Change activeFlowMismatch to accept the requested runId and pass `runId` from the runId branch, then set `expectedRunId` to that value in the ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH data.
blockingFindings.rationale: The explicit runId form is a core integration point in the spec; omitting expectedRunId prevents callers from reliably identifying which target flow was requested when a mismatch occurs.
